chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Fazal, from Thal'ata ibn Maymun, from Al-Tayyar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the statement of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic
We will show them Our signs in the horizons and in their own souls, until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth
He said: Submerging, metamorphosis, and stoning. I said: 'Until it becomes clear to them'? He said: Leave that. That is the rising of the Rising One.

key_terms.خَسْف: Submerging or sinking into the earth
key_terms.قِيَامُ الْقَائِمِ: The rising/appearance of the Awaited One (Al-Qa'im)

ai.seo_question: What are the signs in the horizons and souls mentioned in Surah Fussilat according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets the cosmic and internal signs in Surah Fussilat as the phenomena of submerging (khasf), metamorphosis (makhk), and stoning (qathf), which manifest in the horizons. He clarifies that the ultimate realization of truth ('until it becomes clear to them') is specifically tied to the appearance (qiyam) of the Mahdi (Al-Qa'im), linking eschatological signs to the culmination of divine guidance in Shia tradition.
